transferTax.stateRateDescription: None: no statewide real estate transfer, documentary stamp or conveyance tax; only recording fees apply
transferTax.notes: No transfer tax is due on any deed. NAR lists Alaska among states without a statewide transfer tax (2023) and the Recorder's Office fee schedule shows only recording fees. Municipal transfer taxes were not separately verified.

sources.label: NAR Focus - State and Local Issues: Real Estate Transfer Tax (trade association, 2023)
sources.quote: 14 states do not have a statewide transfer tax: Alaska, Idaho, Indiana, Louisiana, Kansas, Mississippi, Missouri, Montana, New Mexico, North Dakota, Oregon (most counties), Texas, Utah and Wyoming.

propertyTaxAffidavit.notes: The Recorder's Office minimum recording criteria (AS 40.17.030; 11 AAC 06.040) require a title, indexing data, recording district, legal description and grantor/grantee mailing addresses on deeds, but no transfer-tax return or valuation affidavit.

sources.label: Alaska DNR Recorder's Office - Preparing Documents
sources.quote: Deed documents must contain complete mailing addresses of all persons who grant or acquire an interest.

recording.notes: Statewide DNR Recorder's Office fee is $20.00 for the first page and $5.00 for each additional page (a page is one side of a sheet), so a 1-3 page deed costs $20-$30. A $50.00 non-standard document fee applies if margin or format rules are not met; $2.00 per name indexed beyond six.

sources.label: Alaska DNR Recorder's Office - Fees (first page $20.00; AS 40.17.030; 11 AAC 05.200)
Alaska DNR Recorder's Office - Fees (each additional page)
sources.quote: Each additional page or fraction thereof (same instrument) 5.00
